steps.userMessage:
NORTHBOUND | Regional frozen-food delivery packaging

We need secondary delivery packaging for customers ordering Otaru Double Cheese away from its home region. Our service identity is "NORTHBOUND", with the descriptor "Regional frozen-food delivery". U01 is one complete sealed retail and foam package containing one whole cake of listed diameter 120 mm; its bounding envelope is 160 W × 163 D × 94 H mm. K1 SINGLE, order NB-401, carries one U01. K2 DOUBLE, order NB-402, carries two identical U01 units side by side, upright. The existing retail packages remain intact throughout packing and removal. Our controlled frozen distribution service handles storage and transport; the packaging information should lead recipients clearly from receiving to frozen storage or preparation for serving.

The carton geometry is fixed. K1 has an external envelope of 196 × 200 × 124 mm, a clear interior of 188 × 192 × 116 mm and a usable insert volume of 184 × 188 × 112 mm. K2 has corresponding dimensions of 372 × 200 × 124 mm, 364 × 192 × 116 mm and 360 × 188 × 112 mm. All dimensions follow W × D × H. Both cartons open at the front and hinge across the rear width. Use corrugated kraft paperboard for the cartons and uncoated paperboard for the retaining inserts. Develop the retention, lifting access and graphic system around these envelopes. Each carton needs a blank 100 × 70 mm carrier-label area on top, a separate 100 × 60 mm dispatch-label area on the front and graphics at least 8 mm from the hinge and closure. One 148 × 105 mm opening card sits in a lid pocket clear of the lifting path. Print "Keep frozen" on both cartons and dispatch labels; identify the contents as 1 whole cake on K1 and 2 whole cakes on K2. Use Otaru Double Cheese in plain type as the product identifier.

Audience: customers receiving regional food away from home, and our packing team, for correct order identification, packing and opening.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the product records, materials, dispatch copy and four opening actions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. retail-and-carton-envelopes.en.md records the retail-unit envelope and both carton limits. retail-carton-geometry.png supplies dimensioned views of those envelopes and the front and rear orientation. sealed-retail-unit.png identifies the opaque closed U01 volume around which the secondary packaging fits. kitchen-arrival-reference.png supplies the domestic receiving and storage context.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page structural specification covering both cartons, their external, clear and usable dimensions, the two paperboard materials, front opening, rear hinge, retaining inserts and card pockets
2. A two-page copy and placement schedule covering K1 and K2 exterior wording, dispatch-label lines, original-label referral, opening actions and reserved areas
3. Two dimensioned flat exterior artwork layouts, one per carton, with panel boundaries, front closure, rear hinge, carrier and dispatch areas, and the corresponding pack name and cake count
4. Two retaining-insert boards, one per carton, combining a dimensioned flat cutting and folding layout with a loaded plan, section and lifting-access detail
5. Two dispatch-label artworks, one for NB-401 and one for NB-402, each 100 × 60 mm with a 4 mm text inset
6. One four-page opening-card artwork document containing a front and back for each pack, each side 148 × 105 mm with a 5 mm text inset
7. One 148 × 105 mm dispatch checklist artwork with separate K1 and K2 columns and six empty checkboxes per column
8. One assembled range-display board showing both closed cartons with applied dispatch labels and both open cartons with their complete contents and lid-pocket cards
9. One four-step opening board with parallel K1 and K2 sequences, front-opening cues, complete-unit lifting and the conditional storage and serving branches
10. One 10-second opening video following K2 from front closure to two-unit removal, ending with the frozen-storage and ready-to-serve branches
11. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the specification, copy schedule, exterior layouts, insert boards, labels, cards, checklist, assembled views and opening sequence, with the video storyboard

Acceptance:
- The structural specification, exterior layouts, insert boards and presentation repeat both cartons' external, clear and usable dimensions; the specification, insert boards and presentation name corrugated kraft paperboard and uncoated paperboard in their corresponding uses. The insert plans and sections fit one 160 × 163 × 94 mm upright U01 in K1 and two side-by-side upright U01 units in K2, with visible lifting access.
- The copy schedule, exterior layouts, dispatch labels and assembled range-display board pair K1 SINGLE with NB-401 and 1 whole cake, and K2 DOUBLE with NB-402 and 2 whole cakes. Both exteriors and both dispatch labels carry NORTHBOUND, Regional frozen-food delivery on the exteriors, Otaru Double Cheese, Keep frozen and This way up; the dispatch labels reproduce their seven lines from the fact sheet.
- The exterior layouts and assembled range-display board locate the blank 100 × 70 mm carrier area on top and the separate 100 × 60 mm dispatch area on the front. The exterior layouts dimension the 8 mm graphic clearance at the rear hinge and front closure; the dispatch-label artworks annotate their 100 × 60 mm finish and 4 mm text inset outside the artwork.
- The opening-card document supplies four sides at 148 × 105 mm with a 5 mm text inset: each front names NORTHBOUND and its pack, order and cake count with four numbered actions, and each back prints the original-label referral from the fact sheet. The insert boards and assembled range-display board show one card per carton in a lid pocket clear of the lifting path.
- The opening-card fronts, four-step opening board and 10-second video use the fact sheet's action order: front opening, complete sealed-unit removal, frozen storage when not ready to serve, and foam-box removal before refrigerator storage when ready. The opening board and video distinguish the last two actions as conditional branches and retain the one-unit K1 and two-unit K2 quantities wherever each pack appears.
- The dispatch checklist has K1 / NB-401 / one U01 and K2 / NB-402 / two U01 as separate columns, each with the six fact-sheet checks and empty boxes. The presentation contains at least eight pages and reuses both finished pack systems, the checklist and the four-action sequence with the same names, quantities and dimensions.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
